technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

## The gold standard in safety excellence

At Advanced Technology Services, safety is more than a priority—it’s a core value embedded in our
culture. To put this value into action, we launched the [Beyond Zero program][64], a proactive
commitment to employee well-being and safety. Beyond Zero goes beyond aiming for zero incidents; it
drives continuous improvement and fosters a culture of holistic care, ensuring our people feel
supported, protected, and empowered—both on and off the job.

technicians bring field‑proven expertise, consistent service standards and a safety-first mindset to

Autobits pioneers smart manufacturing with IIoT integration and digital twins. Our IoT gateways
gather real-time data from various sensors and machinery, feeding accurate models of manufacturing
processes.

Smart
Manufacturing
System Analytics

This data is easily linked into Digital Twins, resulting in an accurate and real-time machine
monitoring model of actual manufacturing processes. 

### Real-time Data Monitoring

IIoT solution collects and analyzes data in real-time monitoring with Industrial IoT from a variety
of sensors and devices on the manufacturing floor. This enables the instant detection of
inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.

### KPI Reporting

Advanced analytics generate comprehensive data on machine performance, production metrics, and
operation efficiency. Furthermore, it assists firms in making data-driven decisions, optimizing
operations, and reducing downtime.

### Alert Notification

Alert systems make it easier to keep an eye on the condition and health of connected devices. And to
enable preventative maintenance, automated alerts can inform operators of possible issues before
they become more serious.

Predictive Analytics 

### Anomaly Detection

This early alert system helps to avoid major issues and maintain continuous, effective
manufacturing, as well as detect anomalies and deviations from regular operating conditions. 

Predictive Maintenance Analytics 

Our IoT gateways offer predictive maintenance in industrial automation by using historical and
real-time data, reducing unexpected downtime and maintenance costs while increasing machinery
durability.

Digital Twin Applications

### Virtual Replication

Our digital twin technology creates virtual replicas of actual inventory, processes, and systems.
That allows the analysis and optimization of procedures in a risk-free digital setting, leading to
better decision-making and operational efficiency.

### Enhanced Insights 

Digital twins provide a complete picture of the whole manufacturing process, from each machine to
the entire production line. Identify problems, reduce processes, and improve overall productivity.

# BMS Service & Maintenance
* **Carrying out weekly, monthly, or yearly PPM checks **are proven to make savings on both reactive
  calls and energy.
* **Our trained BMS engineers are manufacturer trained.**
* **A fully detailed report** listing comprehensive checks together with recommendations is
  submitted upon completion of each inspection.
* **The report is backed up** by a prompt estimating service to ensure minimum amount of downtime.
* **The BMS help desk is fully manned **during normal working hours and for all contract customers,
  we provide an out-of-hours facility contactable through our bureau service.

[ Find Out More ][44]

## Bureau

**Where required, sites can be connected (via ISDN or wireless router) to our established 24/7
bureau engineer.**

Customer’s sites are connected via modem with the customer’s BMS operating system mirrored on our
own secure IT network. System alarms can be configured to be automatically transmitted to the
engineer to suit the sites and/or customer’s requirements. For example:
* **All critical alarms transmitted are followed up **by telephone response from the engineer back
  to the site to ensure alarms are being attended to.
* **Only alarms generated out-of-normal hours **are transmitted to the engineer, empowered to follow
  an agreed escalation process.
* **On-site customer engineers/representatives **that proactively contact BMS controls to request
  that the bureau engineer remotely “drive” the installed BMS system to assist other on-site tasks.

[ Find Out More ][45]

## Audits

**BMS controls conduct high-level Building Energy Management System (BEMS) audits to evaluate the
performance of the control system and to identify measures that will reduce energy consumption costs
and carbon dioxide emissions**

## What you worry about, solved

### 01. Can’t find the exact sensor match?

Many trucks share the same engine but use different sensors by year or connector, so easy to order
the wrong part.
Send us your VIN + old-part photos, and our engineers will match OE numbers, connector type and
length before we quote and ship, cutting wrong deliveries and returns.

[ Contact Us ][11]

### 02. Not sure about goods quality?

Aftermarket parts vary, disputes in warranty.
Every batch goes through 100% inbound & outbound testing, key models get high/low temperature and
life-cycle bench tests, and each carton has a traceable batch code plus warranty support.

[ Contact Us ][12]

### 03. How do you secure shipping?

We keep safety stock on core SKUs, so most orders ship within 24–48 hours.
courier/air/sea options and full tracking with lead-time commitment help you avoid stock gaps and
costly downtime.

[ Contact Us ][13]

## WHY CHOOSE US

[ Predictable supply for wholesale programs ][14]

Multi-warehouse strategy in China with rolling safety stock on core SKUs. Weekly capacity planning
ensures stable availability during peaks. 

[ Cross-border logistics you can plan around ][15]

Consolidated shipping, export documents ready (commercial invoice, packing list, HS codes), and
carrier options for air/sea. Clear lead-time tiers: 5 days ex-works, 7-15 days door-to-door to
EU/LatAm hubs.

[ Total landed cost advantage without quality trade-offs ][16]

Tiered pricing for volume, fixed packing specs, and optimized cartons to reduce dimensional weight.
Batch-level traceability keeps warranty risk low.

[ Quality you can trace, warranty you can rely on ][17]

Two-stage QC (inbound/outbound), serialized labels, and retained samples by lot. Warranty terms
aligned for wholesale replacements and credit notes.

[ VIN and photo-matching that reduces returns ][18]

Fast model/connector verification before purchase via VIN and old-part photos. (48h confirmation
window) Low return rate on core SKUs (<0.8% rolling 12 months).

[ Compliance and documentation ready for customs ][19]

IATF 16949 processes, RoHS material declarations, IP ratings where applicable, MSDS and test reports
available per request. Smooth customs clearance reduces delays.

[ Flexible payment and risk control ][20]

Multiple trade terms (EXW/FOB/CIF/DDP by arrangement), payment options (T/T, L/C for qualified
partners), and credit lines for long-term distributors.

[ Post-sale support built for distributors ][21]

Installation guides, failure analysis reports within 3 business days, and RMA portal designed for
batch handling. Root-cause feedback loops to protect your brand.

Aftermarket parts vary, disputes in warranty.
Every batch goes through 100% inbound & outbound testing, key models get high/low temperature and
life-cycle bench tests, and each carton has a traceable batch code plus warranty support.

[ Contact Us ][12]

EU/LatAm hubs.

aligned for wholesale replacements and credit notes.

window) Low return rate on core SKUs (<0.8% rolling 12 months).

available per request. Smooth customs clearance reduces delays.

[ Flexible payment and risk control ][20]

partners), and credit lines for long-term distributors.

[ Post-sale support built for distributors ][21]

batch handling. Root-cause feedback loops to protect your brand.

tools, calculators and selectors. Each application can be used in a web browser. For mobile
versions, download the mySchneider mobile app to access these tools and much more. [Discover the
app][1]..

**Languages**: English, [French][2]

also available within the selector.

**Available for**: US and Canada

**Languages**: English, [French][5]

[Launch »][6]

Fault Current Calculator +

Quickly create a single or three phase system and calculate the fault current.

and email the label to yourself or a colleague.

**Available for**: US and Canada

**Languages**: English

[Launch »][7]

Transformer Data Calculator +

Provides ampacity for single & three phase dry type transformers based on voltage and KVA, anytime
and anywhere!

conduit sizes ranging from 1/2 to 4-1/2 inches.

****Available for****: US and Canada

# Leading Smart Thermostat OEM/ODM Manufacturer with 20+ Years Experience

## **Your Global Expert in Smart HVAC & IoT Control**

 

**Who is E-TOP?**

Founded in 2003, E-top is a premier ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified manufacturer with
over 20 years of dedicated expertise in the thermostat industry. Operating from an 8,000 m²
professional facility, we specialize in [high-end ODM/OEM solutions][96] for global heating and
cooling markets. Our mission is to combine innovation with passion to create a smarter, sustainable
"Green World" through precision climate control.

[E-top professional thermostat factory with SMT production lines, R&D lab, and QC testing
facilities]

 

 

**Our Manufacturing & R&D Power**

We provide a full-chain manufacturing service, including SMT, Plug-in, Injection, Silk Printing,
Assembly, and rigorous Aging Tests.

**Production Capacity: **5,000+ units per day with a 95%+ on-time delivery rate.

**[Professional R&D][97]: **Supported by a 20-member R&D team, we utilize advanced tools like FMEA,
APQP, and PPAP to ensure world-class product development.

 

**Connectivity Leadership:**

We are at the forefront of IoT integration, supporting:

**Smart Ecosystems: **Official integration with Tuya Smart, Smart Life, Amazon Alexa, and Google
Assistant, and Matter.

**Industrial Protocols: **BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and OpenTherm.

**Wireless **Standards: Zigbee, LoRaWAN, RF (433/868/915MHz), and Bluetooth.

**App Support: **Seamless mobile control via App Store and Google Play applications.

 

 

**World-Class Quality & Certifications**

Quality is our signature. Every E-top thermostat undergoes a complete IQC/IPQC/FQC process in our
professional validation lab. To ensure global market access and user safety, our products are
rigorously tested and carry the world's most recognized safety marks:

**Global Compliance: **TUV, ETL, CE (LVD, EMC, RED), UKCA, and [**EU CRA (Cyber Resilience
Act)**][98]

**Environmental Standards: **RoHS and REACH

[E-top thermostat certifications: TUV, ETL, CE, UKCA, RoHS, REACH]

 

 

 

**Trusted Partners Worldwide**

Our long-term commitment to quality has made us the trusted manufacturing partner for global
industry giants, including:

Carrier, Bosch, Daikin, Danfoss, Viessmann, Belimo, Johnson Controls, Watts, Meross, and more.

## Hard Disk Sentinel

**Hard Disk Sentinel** (HDSentinel) is a **multi-OS** SSD and HDD monitoring and analysis software.
Its goal is to find, test, diagnose and repair hard disk drive problems, report and display SSD and
HDD health, performance degradations and failures. Hard Disk Sentinel gives complete textual
description, tips and displays/reports the most comprehensive information about the hard disks and
solid state disks inside the computer and in external enclosures ([USB hard disks][50] / e-SATA hard
disks). Many different alerts and report options are available to ensure maximum safety of your
valuable data.

No need to use separate tools to verify internal hard disks, external hard disks, SSDs, hybrid disk
drives (SSHD), disks in RAID arrays and Network Attached Storage (NAS) drives as these are **all
included in a single software.** In addition Hard Disk Sentinel Pro detects and displays status and
S.M.A.R.T. information about **LTO tape drives** and appropriate [**industrial (micro) SD
cards**][51] and eMMC devices too. See the [How to: monitor Network Attached Storage (NAS)
status][52] for information about hard disk monitoring in Network Attached Storage (NAS) devices.

Hard Disk Sentinel monitors hard disk drive / HDD status including health, temperature and all
[S.M.A.R.T. (Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology)][53] values for all hard disks.
Also it measures the disk transfer speed in real time which can be used as a benchmark or to detect
possible hard disk failures, performance degradations. [How to check hard drive health][54]

**Proven invaluable on our backup server**

Read the success story provided by
[Pan Pacific Products][55] (PDF).

HDSentinel is the perfect data protection solution: it can be effectively used to prevent HDD
failure and SSD / HDD data loss because it has the most sensitive disk health rating system which is
extremely sensitive to disk problems. This way even a small HDD problem can't be missed. The
Professional version has scheduled and automatic (on-problem) disk backup options to prevent data
loss caused by not only failure but by malware or accidental delete also.

### How does Hard Disk Sentinel work?

Hard Disk Sentinel runs in the background and verifies SSD / HDD health status by inspecting the
SMART status of the disk(s). If an error is found or unexpected behaviour is detected, it warns the
user about the current situation and also can perform appropriate actions (for example, start an
automatic backup).

Usually, hard disk health status may slowly decline, from day to day. The SMART monitoring
technology can predict HDD failure by examining the critical values of the disk drive. Compared to
other software, **Hard Disk Sentinel detects and reports every disk problem**. It is much more
sensitive to disk failures and can display better and more detailed information about hard disk
expected life and the problems found (if any). This is a more sophisticated way to predict failures
than the "traditional" method: checking S.M.A.R.T. attribute thresholds and values only. For more
information, please read [how hard disk S.M.A.R.T. works][56] and why Hard Disk Sentinel is
different. [Signs of a hard drive failure][57]

The software displays the current hard disk temperature and logs maximum and average HDD
temperatures. This may be used to check the maximum temperature under high hard disk load. For the
importance of the hard disk operating temperature, see the [Frequently Asked Questions][58]. See the
list of [Features of Hard Disk Sentinel Professional][59] or our [products for hard disk
monitoring][60].

### Do I need Hard Disk Sentinel?

If you are using a computer equipped with at least one hard disk or solid state disk and you want to
ensure that your data will be available any time, then the answer is YES. Hard Disk Sentinel is
especially designed to you if
* you are using multiple hard disks / SSDs / hybrid drives (SSHD) in your computer (IDE / Serial ATA
  (S-ATA, e-SATA) / NVMe / SCSI / SAS / [USB hard disks][61]) or in an external enclosure (check the

  Health][63]
* you are using a mobile / removable rack or enclosure with hard disk inside
* you are using notebook computer

# Advanced machinery telematics

[Advanced machinery telematics by Technoton]

We offer comprehensive solutions for remote monitoring of road and off-road trucks, locomotives, sea
and river vessels, diesel generators (gensets), fuel storages and tanks, technological machines.
Major parameters monitored are: [fuel consumption][56], time and engine operation mode, volume and
temperature of fuel, operation of attached equipment, axle load.

**[Documentation][57]**

**[Software][58]**

**[Training][59]**

**[ODM services][60]**

**[Documentation][61]**

**[Software][62]**

**[Training][63]**

**[ODM services][64]**

Technoton [telematics solutions][65] allow machinery owners and operators to dramatically improve
efficiency of operation and decrease costs.

Our expertise:
* Fuel consumption monitoring of diesel engines
* Monitoring of stationary and movable/mobile fuel tanks
* Contactless reading, analysis and conversion of data from CAN j1939 and j1708 buses
* Data integration of standard CAN j1939 and j1708 buses into telematics and GPS monitoring systems
* Integration of standard analog sensors into telematics systems

## **Welcome to Monitra (formerly HVPD). **

**Founded in 2006 with headquarters in the UK and locations around the world, we have developed
cutting edge high voltage partial discharge monitoring and testing technology to ensure your high
voltage networks are safe and reliable, avoiding dangerous and costly unplanned outages.**


At Monitra, we supply a comprehensive range of equipment suitable for the condition assessment of
in-service Medium Voltage (MV), High Voltage
(HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) power cables, switchgear, transformers, generators and motors
including Variable/Frequency Drives.

## Introducing Atlas by Monitra™

# Atlas by Monitra™

## The transformational cloud-based data management platform

**Our new flagship platform. **Monitor plant and asset condition, benchmark health rankings,
generate reports, and receive recommended maintenance priorities from anywhere in the world.

[Explore Atlas by Monitra™][8]

## For any help or inquiries about how we can help you, call us on [+1 (281) 524 7480][9] or
## complete our online inquiry form

## **What is Partial Discharge?**

High voltage partial discharge is a degenerative phenomenon that affects the electrical insulation
of medium voltage and high voltage equipment.

### **Partial discharge monitoring**

[PD monitoring][10] provides the best early warning indicator of electrical degradation in high and
medium voltage assets.

### **Condition-based maintenance**

PD testing and monitoring supports condition-based maintenance programmes, enabling operators to
improve their asset reliability and avoid unplanned outages.

### **Outage prevention**

By providing a condition assessment of in-service assets, Monitra helps operators avoid in-service
failures, reduce unplanned outages and improve their maintenance efficiency - saving them time and
money.

Read more [here.][11]

## **What is Partial Discharge?**

High voltage partial discharge is a degenerative phenomenon that affects the electrical insulation
of medium voltage and high voltage equipment.

### **Partial discharge monitoring**

[PD monitoring][10] provides the best early warning indicator of electrical degradation in high and
medium voltage assets.

### **Condition-based maintenance**

PD testing and monitoring supports condition-based maintenance programmes, enabling operators to
improve their asset reliability and avoid unplanned outages.

### **Outage prevention**

By providing a condition assessment of in-service assets, Monitra helps operators avoid in-service
failures, reduce unplanned outages and improve their maintenance efficiency - saving them time and
money.

## Everything you need to pitch with confidence

From deck feedback to financial research, PitchGrade gives founders and analysts the tools to make
smarter decisions.

### AI Deck Review

Get a detailed score, structured feedback, and actionable suggestions on every slide of your pitch
deck.

### Investor Matching

See how your deck fits with 20+ top investors like Sequoia, a16z, and YC — or enter your own target
investor.

### Research AgentNew

An autonomous agent that builds DCF models, pulls SEC filings, runs peer comps, and writes
investment theses — without you lifting a finger.

[Try it free →][2]

### Slide Generator

Generate styled, investor-ready PPTX slide decks from a prompt — powered by AI and ready to
download.

### Live Financial Data

Real-time stock quotes, income statements, analyst consensus, and insider activity for thousands of
companies.

### Company Comparison

Compare up to 4 companies side by side on market cap, revenue, margins, P/E ratio, and more.

### Upload your deck

## FAQ

How does the Propel app work?

Propel connects to your state's portal with your permission. Then, Propel gathers your EBT balance
and transaction history, makes it easier to read, and displays it in the app.

This means you don't need to call a 1-800 number or log in to a state website.
The app also helps you manage your benefits with:
* **Deposit predictions**, so you know when your next payment is coming
* **Clear transaction details**, including store names and online purchases
* **Security features**, like fraud monitoring and out-of-state transaction blocking

Is the Propel app free?

Yes! The Propel app is completely free to use.

Does the Propel app work in all states?

The Propel app offers balance checking in 49 states, the District of Columbia, and several U.S.
territories, including Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Guam.

Balance checking is currently not available in Iowa.

How does the Propel app make money?

We make money through advertising, but we’re selective about what we promote.

Most offers are free or discounted services only available to EBT cardholders—like free phones,
discounted internet, and grocery savings at major retailers.

What else does the Propel app offer?

The Propel app is more than just balance checking—here are some of our additional features:
* EBT security features, like suspicious activity monitoring & out of state transaction blocking
* Easy-to-understand updates about changes to policy or benefits programs, so you’re always in the
  loop
* Exclusive offers & discounts on groceries, utilities, and phone & internet bills
* Job & gig opportunities that fit your schedule

# Industrial **Solutions** for a **Sustainable** Future.

TMEIC is a global leader in industrial systems and solutions. We leverage our combined expertise to
drive innovation and efficiency across various sectors worldwide.

### Renewable Energy

As the creator of the world’s first 1000kW photovoltaic inverter, TMEIC’s development team has long
been a solutions innovator in alternative energy systems.

[ Learn more ][79]

### Crane systems and port technology

TMEIC is a leader in advanced control and automation technology for ports and terminals worldwide.

[ Learn more ][80]

### Carbon Neutrality

TMEIC provides diverse solutions to realize carbon neutrality. – Contributing to society with
exceptional technology and partnering with our customers –

[ Learn more ][81]

### Metals

TMEIC’s Industrial Systems engineers are the leading force in ferrous and nonferrous metals
production around the world and have been for more than 50 years.

[ Learn more ][82]

## Driving Industry **Forward:** the TMEIC Advantage

The [TMEIC 21-H Series motor][83] is a high-performance industrial motor that serves multiple
sectors including conveyors, metals, marine propulsion, mining, rubber and plastics, utility plants,
and water applications.

TMEIC drives industry around the world through a comprehensive offering of unique systems solutions
including variable frequency drives, motors, photovoltaic inverters and advanced automation systems
for a wide range of industrial applications.

Vertiq makes high performance propulsion systems for commercial and defense UAS. The core design
consists of a lightweight, tightly integrated motor and ESC with an embedded position sensor. With
position sensing and Vertiq’s sophisticated motor calibration and control software, vehicles
experience significant performance advantages.

Vertiq’s integrated motor and ESC design with position sensing gives it significant advantages over
standard UAS propulsion systems. With rotor position information, tight motor-ESC pairing, and
sophisticated motor control software, Vertiq optimizes propulsion performance and reliability.

## 2025 Achievements & Business Highlights

In 2025, Vibrotech Trainers & Consultants Pvt. Ltd. marked 20 years of excellence in vibration
analysis and condition monitoring services. The company achieved a 30% growth in customer base,
retained 100% of AMC clients, and saw 25% of AMC customers extend contracts to bi-yearly terms,
reflecting strong trust and service quality.

Key achievements included the launch of Condition Monitoring in two Atomic Power Station projects,
conversion of ONGC vibration studies into a 3-year AMC, expansion of services to Government of India
sectors such as Navy, Oil & Gas, and Nuclear Plants, etc. Commencement of vibration analyser
calibration services in accordance with our principals, M/s VMI AB International, Sweden, further
strengthening our technical capabilities.

Additionally, we carried out building vibration measurements in multiple hospitals, including zone-
listed sensitive locations, ensuring compliance, safety, and operational reliability.

These achievements reaffirm Vibrotech’s position as a trusted partner in vibration analysis,
calibration, and reliability solutions for industrial and government sectors across India.
